name: dorbar-skills
description: Dor Bar's personal marketplace of Claude Code skills, plugins, and hooks shared across projects.

plugins.name: agent-workflows
plugins.description: Agent workflow patterns from ICM practice: decide what to automate (workflow-audit), turn chat corrections into a skill (corrections-to-skill), retry a check under a written stop rule (bounded-loop), route repeated judgement calls by confidence (decision-gates), and fan work out to parallel sub-agents and merge it without conflicting facts (parallel-branches).

plugins.name: knowledge-from-sources
plugins.description: Turn transcripts, courses, interviews and research into a linked, quote-checked knowledge bundle.

plugins.name: layered-context
plugins.description: Layered, agent-readable context (ICM) for software projects: scaffold/restructure AGENTS.md + CONTEXT.md + references/ + runs/, keep it small as features pile up (context-hygiene), map a codebase with path:line cards and an impact index (system-map), and pause/resume tasks (session-handoff).

plugins.name: multi-lens-review
plugins.description: Multi-lens code review of a PR or branch: parallel specialist reviewers (functionality, language, testing, data model, security, performance, simplicity, code architecture, frontend and design system) and a master reviewer that verifies, dedupes and ranks into one report. Use when asked for a thorough, multi-perspective, or multi-agent code review.

plugins.name: obsidian-knowledge
plugins.description: Manage project knowledge in an Obsidian vault — capture durable facts, decisions, and status for humans and agents.

plugins.name: reel-creator
plugins.description: Idea to finished vertical reel: story, script, shoot plan, music map, CapCut build, review and learning loop, as a layered staged workspace.

plugins.name: repo-vetting
plugins.description: Read-only vetting of a third-party repository (Claude Code skill or plugin, MCP server, library, template) before you install or depend on it: scan hooks, install scripts, network and credential access, injection text; report the exact commit, verdict and unknowns.

plugins.name: verified-web-edit
plugins.description: Change live web pages (CMS, course platform, docs site, store listing) through a browser agent with a verify-after-each-edit loop and one result row per page; stops on the first mismatch.
